review.why: Unified design skill: brand, tokens, UI styling, AI logo and icon generation, identity mockups, slides, banners and social images, routed by task.
review.summary: A router over sub-skills (brand, design system, UI styling) and built-in areas for logos, corporate identity mockups, presentations, banners, social photos and icons. Logo and icon work uses bundled Python scripts that search style, color and industry data and call several image-generation services. It sets rules such as white-background logos, asking before a preview and fixing failing scripts.
strengths: Routing table sends each task to the right guide
Searchable style, color and industry data for logos and mockups
Supports several image providers, not just one
cautions: Large: dozens of data, script and reference files are not read here
Image generation needs the user's API keys and paid services
AI-generated logos need human review for originality
